summary: Design a unified, concrete art direction to make the procedural Camera Obscura photography museum (Unity 6 / URP, built at runtime in C#) look like the fanciest museum ever

result.directionSummary: Le Grand Salon Nocturne — a Second-Empire palace lit like a Vermeer. We build a load-bearing stone-and-gilt architecture (banded walls, baseboard/cornice/pilaster order, coffered vaults, arched keystoned doorways, a domed atrium rotunda) but light it for contrast, not flat brightness: warm 3200K pools on the art and cool clerestory daylight in the atrium, with deep protected shadow between. The single highest-ROI move is perceptual fidelity, not geometry — runtime box-projected reflection probes (baked once at boot) plus an SSAO renderer feature plus an ACES warm grade turn the existing meshes into polished marble and carved gilt; without the probes every smoothness value reads as grey plastic, so probes ship first. Photographs stay strictly unlit at true brightness inside 5-layer gilded ogee frames with a recessed linen mat, seated in dimmer walls so each print reads as a hero shot.
result.materials:
All recipes are runtime URP/Lit unless noted; every reflective surface depends on the reflection probes (build probes FIRST or this all looks like plastic). Generate value-noise color+normal at 256px for walls/ceilings, 512px for the hero atrium floor; cap stone _BumpScale at 0.7 globally (1.0 over-reads on plaster, under-reads on marble).

FLOOR — rooms (MaterialLibrary Floor): Carrara value-noise, baseRGB (196,190,182) #C4BEB6, veinRGB (74,70,80), vein 0.45, amp 0.12, smoothness 0.82, metallic 0, normalScale (BumpScale) 0.6 (keep normal LOW so reflections stay mirror-flat), tiling 6.
FLOOR — atrium (AtriumFloor): the hero plane. baseRGB (180,172,160), veinRGB (74,70,80), vein 0.55, amp 0.14, smoothness 0.90, metallic 0, normalScale 0.5, tiling 8, with a faint book-matched read via SetTextureScale(8,16) on one axis. Add a checkerboard inlay radiating from the pool: alternate white Carrara (#C4BEB6, sm 0.86) and Nero/Rosso (#1E1A18, sm 0.90) as 1.2m boxes 0.02m proud, with a thin brass divider strip per tile.
WALL — the #1 cheap win: a TRUE MATTE warm limewash that swallows light so lit art pops. Split the 6m box into stacked bands: baseboard 0–0.25m dark Nero #232021 sm 0.5; dado/wainscot 0.25–1.1m Botticino #D8CBA8 sm 0.20; main field 1.1–5.2m warm plaster #E6DCC6 sm 0.06, normalScale 0.8, amp 0.05 (matte is mandatory — do NOT raise smoothness, busy/shiny walls kill the prints); frieze 5.2–6.0m deeper sandstone #C9B894 sm 0.10. Optional ashlar groove: draw a 1px darker seam into the height field every 1/4 and 1/2 UV before deriving the wall normal so 6m walls read as coursed stone.
CEILING/VAULT (Ceiling): warm sandstone #CEC4B2 → (208,196,176), smoothness 0.04, normalScale 1.2 — relief comes from coffer geometry + SSAO, not texture.
GILDING — the hero metal, two-tone so it reads carved. Gold = Lit baseColor #C9A24B (0.788,0.635,0.294), metallic 1.0, smoothness 0.84, emissive #3A2C0E at intensity 0.35 (so gilt still glints in Night mood and Bloom kisses it). AntiqueGold = #B8860B (0.722,0.525,0.043), metallic 1.0, smoothness 0.60 — paint ONLY recessed ogee valleys / scotia channels with this so the highlight skips them and relief reads. Discipline: gold is an accent EDGE, never a slab.
BRONZE (structural ribs, picture-light housings, plaques): #6E5A33, metallic 1.0, smoothness 0.55.
MARBLE (busts/columns/fountain): #EDEAE2 (0.93,0.92,0.88), smoothness 0.50 (statuary is honed not wet), metallic 0, value-noise normal at BumpScale 0.6 so busts aren't billiard-ball smooth.
WALNUT (frame back rail): #2A1E14, smoothness 0.40, metallic 0 — the dark anchor that makes gold read as gold.
LINEN MAT: #E9E0CF, smoothness 0.08, metallic 0.
WATER (pool/fountain): baseColor (0.10,0.16,0.20), smoothness 0.95, metallic 0.6, faint emissive (0.02,0.03,0.04) so it never goes pure black at night; the atrium probe supplies the mirror.
result.architecture:
Add five procedural relief systems, ALL from stacked GO.Box extrusions + existing MeshFactory (BarrelVault, Torus, Cylinder, Quad, Arch). Build once in MuseumBuilder.Build so it static-batches/combines. Reference existing constants WALL_H=6, DOOR_W=3.0, ATRIUM_HALF=9. Miter corners by overlap, not true 45° — reads fine and batches.

1) BASEBOARD + CORNICE on every wall (iterate L.walls; highest realism-per-vert, hides the CG floor/wall seam). Baseboard: 0.22m tall × 0.05m proud, Nero marble, at y=0.11. Cornice at the vault springline y=5.2–6.0m: 3-step corbel — fascia 0.25m tall proud 0.10m (sandstone) + bed-mould bead 0.12m proud 0.08m (Gold) + cyma 0.16m proud 0.05m (sandstone), the bead tinted Gold. This single line is THE "grand gallery" tell and hides the wall/vault seam everywhere.
2) CHAIR-RAIL/DADO cap: a 0.06m Gold box at y=1.1m proud 0.03m, separating dado from field — instantly makes flat walls read as paneled.
3) PILASTERS at every doorway reveal and every 4.5m along atrium long walls (align to the 6m GlassRoof tie-beam rhythm): 0.50m-wide × 0.14m-proud × 4.2m fluted shaft (3 recessed 0.02m vertical box-grooves = fake flutes), Botticino, on a 0.55m Nero base block, capped by a Corinthian-ish capital = 0.6m box + inverted small box + 4 corner Gold cubes (1.0m tall total). Flank each gateway with a pilaster PAIR so it reads as a portal.
4) ARCHED DOORWAYS WITH KEYSTONE: add an Arch(width,thickness,rise) mesh = extruded half-annulus; place over each DOOR_W=3.0m opening springing at y=2.6m (radius 1.5), Botticino, with a single proud Gold trapezoid keystone box (0.4×0.6×0.18m) at the crown.
5) COFFERED/RIBBED VAULTS — the ceiling money shot. On each barrel vault lay Gold-bronze rib boxes following the arc: transverse curved ribs (reuse vault arc points, 0.10m square section) every 2.2m along Z, plus 3 longitudinal ribs at arc angles π/4, π/2, 3π/4. Drop a small Gold rosette (squashed sphere + Torus(0.18,0.03)) at each rib intersection. BOUNDED: ~6 transverse × 3 longitudinal per room max, combined into the static mesh.
6) NICHES on blank back walls (every other pilaster bay): recess a 1.0×2.2×0.35m box of darker Wall material behind the wall plane and seat a MarblePolished bust on a corbel — turns dead walls into a Borghese gallery and lets hero works sit in shadow.
result.lighting:
Contrast-first + reflection-first. Default mood = warm gallery dusk, not flat Day. Hard 3-tier realtime budget for M4 60fps.

REFLECTION PROBES (BUILD THESE FIRST — highest ROI; without them every smoothness value is grey plastic): instantiate runtime ReflectionProbe components, ReflectionProbeMode.Baked refreshed via script — call probe.RenderProbe() ONCE after MuseumBuilder.Build (static museum → zero per-frame cost). One box-projected probe per artist room (box = room bounds) and per movement corridor at res 64; 2–3 down the atrium + 1 hero at the atrium/fountain centre (y=2.5–4m) at res 128. boxProjection=true sized to each bounds so floor reflections track the walls. ~140 probes baked-once @ 64px is cheap.

AMBIENT — kill flat fill: RenderSettings.ambientMode = Trilight. sky (0.30,0.31,0.36) cool skylight, equator (0.20,0.18,0.15) warm stone, ground (0.06,0.05,0.04) dark. Warm-light/cool-shadow separation is the single biggest "this is flat CG" fix and the core "expensive museum" tell.

TIER A — KEY: keep the single directional Sun, recolor warm-neutral (1.0,0.95,0.88) #FFF1DC, Euler (55,-28,0) so it rakes through the glass roof onto the atrium floor (the hero shaft), intensity 1.15 Day / 0.7 Dusk, Soft shadows, shadowStrength 0.55.
TIER B — FILL: keep the 8-light roaming HallLighting pool but DEMOTE it to fill — recolor 3000–3200K #FFD9A8, range 16m, intensity 0.85 normal / 1.3 featured. Galleries are dimmer than you think.
TIER C — PICTURE LIGHTS become REAL (the museum money shot): for each CURRENTLY-LOADED artwork (rooms already distance-gated by RoomController → live count naturally bounded to ~6–12 in the room you're in), add ONE Spot parented to the brass picture-light bar, color 3200K (1.0,0.80,0.55), intensity 18–22, range 5, spotAngle 38, innerSpotAngle 22, aimed down the wall normal onto the frame, Soft shadows ON for these only. Warm pools on art against dimmer walls is the core hanging gesture — reserve full intensity for featured works.
ATRIUM clerestory: keep the warm roof point; add 2 cool stationary "skylight" points high on the atrium long walls (#DCEBFF / (0.86,0.92,1.0), range 30, intensity 1.4) for the warm-interior/cool-daylight split.
BUDGET: 1 sun + 8 fill pool + (6–12 gated spots) + 3 atrium = comfortably under M4 limit in Forward+. Keep emissive picture-light strips for Bloom. Drive mood brightness through ColorAdjustments postExposure, NOT light intensities, so Bloom thresholds stay stable and unlit photos never blow out.
result.signage:
Kill ALL floating quads (gateway accent quads, cream plaque quads, floating bio card). Everything is physically mounted to a wall/podium and lit by the room — readability comes from contrast against a dim wall, never from emissive body copy. Use the chiseled-bevel trick: render TMP twice, deep incised color #2B2417 with a second offset copy 1px down-right in #FFFFFF at 25% alpha — fakes engraving with no shader.

ARTWORK PLAQUE: a real bronze plate, 3-box bevel — back plate Bronze #6E5A33 (metallic 1, sm 0.55) 0.34×0.24×0.012m, recessed inner panel inset 0.008m (darker bronze) so SSAO shades the lip, a 2mm Gold reveal border. Engraved Gold-toned title line; near-black body. Mount FLUSH+0.02m proud at a consistent 1.45m centre to the lower-right of each frame (museum standard reading height, lower than the current 2.6m).

GATEWAY (movement) SIGN: a marble cartouche over the arch — Botticino tablet 4.6×1.35×0.08m with a 0.06m Gold ogee border (4 thin Gold boxes), recessed 0.03m into the wall, mounted on the flanking pilaster pair so it reads as a real lintel. Movement name in GILT incised TMP (#C9A24B, serif-feel caps with tracking); period below smaller/italic-weight. The movement ACCENT color survives ONLY as a slim 0.04m inlaid line under the name + the floor runner — never as a glowing billboard. Wash each with one warm spot or a Gold uplight bar at its base.

BIO KIOSK: build a real LECTERN, not a floating card — a 0.6×1.1×0.4m angled marble podium (top tilted 18°) on a Nero base, the cream reading panel (#F0E8D6, ink #1A1812) inset into the tilted top with a thin Gold edge, engraved TMP. Frame it in a slim Bronze reveal.
result.frames:
Replace the 2-box frame in ArtworkLoader.BuildArtwork with a 5-layer gilded ogee, all stacked boxes (no custom mesh), corners mitered by overlap. Photo quad stays UNLIT at true brightness, untouched. Total depth ~0.16m, border ~0.20m. Per side, outer→inner, centered on the photo plane:
(1) Outer back rail / cyma — Walnut #2A1E14 box, the dark anchor, w+0.34 × h+0.34 × 0.14m, pushed back to z=-0.06.
(2) Outer Gold ovolo crown — Gold #C9A24B (metallic 1, sm 0.84, emissive #3A2C0E×0.35), w+0.24 × 0.13m deep, the proud outermost gilt lip, z=-0.04.
(3) Scotia/cove valley — AntiqueGold #B8860B (sm 0.60), 0.06m wide, RECESSED 0.03m back, z=-0.02 — the shadowed channel that makes gold read as carved (do not skip; this is why gold looks gilt and not mustard plastic).
(4) Inner Gold sight-edge bead — thin 0.025m Gold box, proud, at the photo plane — the sparkle line that catches Bloom.
(5) LINEN MAT — #E9E0CF (sm 0.08) flat board, 0.10m visible margin, set 0.015m BEHIND the sight edge so it reads as a recessed bevel mat. This single addition makes every print read as mounted, not pasted.
Photo quad UNLIT at z=0.04.
Scale the profile width with the work (clamp 0.09–0.16m crown) — small prints get thin frames, the 3.2m masters get chunky gold.
FEATURED-ONLY extras (gate to bound transparent overdraw): a single Glass quad 0.01m in front of the photo, existing Glass material at alpha 0.06 / smoothness 0.97, angled 0.5° so it catches one soft probe highlight (photo stays unlit underneath); plus a 0.5×0.5m Gold corner ornament (squashed sphere + tiny Torus) at each corner. Non-featured: simpler 3-box gold+walnut to keep variety and draw calls sane.
result.post:
Rebuild the URP Volume in Bootstrap.BuildPostFX (currently only Neutral tonemap + Bloom 0.45 + Vignette). Drive the three moods (Day/Dusk/Night) through postExposure ONLY, not light intensities.
TONEMAPPING: Neutral → ACES (filmic warm rolloff that flatters marble + gilt). Guard the unlit photos: if ACES clips them, fall back to Neutral + ColorAdjustments contrast +8. Keep emissive (gold/bulbs/picture strips) as the ONLY things crossing the Bloom threshold.
COLOR ADJUSTMENTS (currently absent): postExposure +0.15 Day / -0.4 Dusk / -1.1 Night (this is the master brightness knob), contrast +12, saturation +6, colorFilter warm cream #FFF3E2.
WHITE BALANCE (add): temperature +12, tint +3 — pushes the whole room candle/skylight-warm.
BLOOM: intensity 0.45 → 0.85, threshold 0.9 → 1.05 (above 1.0 keeps true-brightness unlit photos from blooming), scatter 0.62, tint #FFE6C0.
VIGNETTE: soften intensity 0.30 → 0.26, smoothness 0.5, color WARM near-black #120B05 (not neutral).
DEPTH OF FIELD (add, Bokeh): focusDistance ~6m, focalLength 50, aperture f/5.6 — distant halls go cinematic-soft, reading distance stays sharp; gate OFF during tour fly-throughs. Gaussian (start 18m end 45m) is the cheaper M4 fallback if Bokeh costs too much.
FILM GRAIN (add): Thin1, intensity 0.18, response 0.8 — kills banding on smooth marble gradients (the #1 cheap-realtime tell) and gives a fine-art photographic tooth, on-theme for a photography museum.
CHROMATIC ABERRATION: 0.06, a whisper at edges only — do not overdo in a fine-art context.
SSAO (URP Renderer Feature — renderer currently has m_RendererFeatures: []; add ScreenSpaceAmbientOcclusion at runtime): Intensity 0.6, Radius 0.35, Falloff 100, Quality/SampleCount Medium(8), Source DepthNormals, Direct Lighting Strength 0.25, half-res + blur on. This seats every new baseboard/cornice/pilaster/coffer/frame/niche into contact shadow — the second-biggest fidelity jump after probes; without it the relief reads as decals.
AA: switch FXAA → SMAA (cleaner gilt + TMP edges); keep the pipeline's existing MSAA 4x if M4 headroom allows.
result.atrium:
Make the spine a domed rotunda + peristyle nave, the establishing shot. Walk in → a cathedral of cool daylight and warm gold mirrored in a wet-marble floor, fountain mirror-still at centre.
DOME: over the fountain (poolX=11), spring a procedural coffered hemisphere — lathe/revolve a quarter-arc profile, radius ~7m, on a 1.2m Nero+Gold drum with a clerestory ring of 8 tall glass lights throwing godrays onto the water. Add a Gold oculus Torus(4.0,0.25) ring at the apex.
COLONNADE/PERISTYLE: ring the spine with marble columns at the existing statuary x-positions (the loop from atriumMinX, pairs both sides) — fluted Cylinder r0.45 × 5.0–6m (8–12 thin vertical box flutes) on a 0.9m square plinth, Attic base of stacked Tori, Gold Corinthian capital. Around the fountain specifically, 8 full columns on a raised 0.3m circular dais with Nero/Carrara radial inlay. Turns the corridor into a Louvre rotunda and the long warm reflection of lit columns down the 60m floor IS the breathtaking shot.
FOUNTAIN: keep the tiers; upgrade to MarblePolished, add a Gold finial + 8 small Gold rim finials + 4 Gold scroll brackets under the top tier; make water the new black-mirror Water material so the dome/columns reflect; underlight the basin with one warm point (#FFD9A0, intensity 6, range 5).
ROOF: add Gold ribs following the BarrelVault arc every 2m so the glass canopy reads as ornate iron-and-glass (d'Orsay), not a plain shell.
GODRAYS (fake, cheap — no real volumetrics on M4): 4–6 large soft additive Unlit quads (radial gradient, #FFF4DC, alpha 0.08) hung under the apex, slowly drifting via a tiny vertex/transform sine — reads as dust-lit shafts.
CHANDELIER: hang ONE grand Gold chandelier on the dome axis (scale existing Chandelier ×2.5, 24 bulbs, two Gold rings) + 2 more down the spine on the 6m beam rhythm.
BANNERS: 4 tall double-sided movement-accent-color quads (1.2×4m) on Gold rods from the drum, gently waving via a tiny vertex sine — heraldic, vertical color against the warm stone.
FLOOR: the checkerboard inlay radiates from the pool; the smoothness-0.90 atrium floor + the hero probe mirrors the dome, columns and chandelier. Keep butterflies but halve to 6 and warm wings #E8C9A0.
implementationOrder: 1. REFLECTION PROBES first — instantiate runtime box-projected ReflectionProbes (1/room + 1/corridor @ res 64, 2-3 atrium + 1 hero @ res 128), call RenderProbe() once after MuseumBuilder.Build. This is the prerequisite that makes every later material/smoothness change pay off; nothing looks expensive without it.

2. SSAO renderer feature — add ScreenSpaceAmbientOcclusion to the URP renderer at runtime (Intensity 0.6, Radius 0.35, DepthNormals, half-res). Seats all relief into contact shadow; required before adding moldings or they read as decals.

3. Warm ACES grade + Trilight ambient — rebuild BuildPostFX (ACES, ColorAdjustments warm cream + postExposure as master, WhiteBalance +12, Bloom threshold 1.05, FilmGrain 0.18, Vignette warm, FXAA→SMAA) and switch RenderSettings.ambientMode Flat→Trilight. ~15 lines, kills the pasted-on CG flatness across the whole building.

4. Polished floors + matte walls — raise Floor smoothness to 0.82 / AtriumFloor 0.90 with LOW normal amplitude (Carrara recipe), and drop the Wall main field to smoothness 0.06 matte limewash with banded baseboard/dado/field/frieze. The two surfaces players look at most; matte walls make the lit art pop.

5. 5-layer gilded ogee frames + linen mat — replace the 2-box frame in ArtworkLoader with Walnut back rail / Gold crown / AntiqueGold recessed scotia / Gold sight bead / recessed linen mat. The eye lingers on frames; the recessed dark valley is what makes gold read as carved.

6. Real picture-light spots — add one distance-gated 3200K warm Spot per loaded artwork (int ~20, angle 38) from the brass bar, and demote the 8-light pool to warm dim fill. Warm pools on art against dim walls is the core museum gesture.

7. Architectural order from boxes — baseboard + 3-step gilt cornice at the 6m springline + chair-rail + pilasters every 4.5m + arched keystoned doorways, all iterated over L.walls and static-combined. Hides seams, makes every threshold a grand event.
8. Coffered/ribbed vaults — gilt-bronze transverse (every 2.2m) + 3 longitudinal ribs with rosettes at intersections (bounded 6x3/room). Ceilings are huge and currently the dullest surface.
9. Engraved mounted signage — replace floating quads with bronze artwork plaques (1.45m, offset-copy engraving), marble gateway cartouches over the arches, and bio lecterns. Nothing floats.

10. Atrium rotunda showpiece — coffered dome on a clerestory drum over the fountain, 8-column peristyle on an inlaid dais, Gold roof ribs, black-mirror underlit fountain, fake godray quads, one grand chandelier, accent banners. The signature hero space, built last on the now-proven systems.
11. Niches + featured-only extras — recessed busts in blank-wall niches, hero-work glass glaze + Gold corner ornaments. Final polish, gated to keep draw calls sane.
risks: Realtime light count: the per-artwork spots (Tier C) plus the 8-light fill pool plus 3 atrium lights could spike if RoomController loads several rooms at once. Mitigate: hard-cap concurrent real spots at ~12 via the existing distance gate, only featured works get full intensity, keep picture-light STRIPS emissive (not real lights), and never make all 131 rooms' lights live.

Reflection probe memory/build time: ~140 probes even at res 64 is a lot of cubemap memory and a multi-frame bake. Mitigate: bake once at boot with time-slicing across frames (show a loading state), drop room probes to res 32 if memory-bound, reuse a shared probe per corridor rather than per-wall, and never set them Realtime/per-frame.

Transparent overdraw from glass: museum-glass quads on all 131 rooms would stack alpha passes down a sightline. Mitigate: gate glass + corner ornaments to FEATURED works only, and angle the glass so it doesn't full-mirror.

ACES clipping the unlit photographs: ACES + postExposure + bloom could crush or halo the true-brightness prints. Mitigate: keep Bloom threshold at 1.05 (above the photo's white), verify photos on screen, and fall back to Neutral tonemap + ColorAdjustments contrast +8 if ACES clips.

SSAO + DoF + SMAA + FilmGrain stacking full-screen passes on M4: could miss 60fps. Mitigate: SSAO at half-res Medium, DoF in Gaussian (cheaper) or gated off during fly-throughs, test the pass budget early and drop ChromaticAberration/Grain first if over.

High smoothness with no probe contribution = grey plastic: if any reflective material is built or shown before its probe bakes, it looks worse than the current flat look. Mitigate: enforce build order — probes and RenderProbe() MUST complete before the high-smoothness materials are visible.

Vertex-shader banner/godray waving and the lathe dome/Arch meshes must be watertight and correctly winding, or they break static batching and SSAO. Mitigate: generate normals/UVs explicitly, validate winding, and keep waving as a cheap transform-level sine rather than per-vertex skinning where possible.

Coffer rib + column + probe geometry can explode draw calls if not combined. Mitigate: keep ribs bounded (6x3/room), build all trim as static and run the existing static mesh combine, and distance-gate room contents exactly as today.
